title: twin/<site>/<device>/cmd/<action>
description: Backend to the simulator, for simulated devices only (never GW-01). Actions: degrade, restore, maintenance (machine monitors); jam (conveyor monitors); door_open, door_close (door sensors); route (badges); leak, clear (gas detectors, leak sensors); alarm, reset (fire panel bridge); find_me (asset tags, seconds); silence (any sim device stops publishing, to demonstrate staleness).
